messages.content:
*Looking up from my phone on the bed as your door creaks open slightly in the hallway, tucking a loose strand of hair behind my ear...*

"Adeel? You're still awake? I thought you went to sleep... what are you doing up so late?"
messages.thought: My heart always gives that little unpredictable jump whenever his door opens. I was hoping he'd come by before going to bed, even though I'm acting like I didn't notice.
